notes.title: COOKING FEST! - 15% OFF Cosmic Kitchen during Early Access Launch!
notes.content:
Hi all! 

We're thrilled to announce that Cosmic Kitchen is taking part in Cooking Fest and we also have a demo build available for those who haven't tried the game yet! 

The game is also discounted at 15% OFF during Early Access launch, so if you're a fan of cooking games, then add it to your library today! 

We'll have a roadmap coming in the near future, but in the meantime we thought we'd share some of the content that'll be arriving in the near future:
[list]
[*] More Great Blue Galaxy Levels
[*] New space monsters
[*] A new food themed galaxy! 
[*] Challenge mode - Play the most difficult levels that the Cosmic Kitchen devs have to offer!
[*] In-game recipe instructions
[*] Sauce for Burgers & Hotdogs (and another secret food item!)
[/list]

We just wanted to thank everyone who has purchased the game so far, if you've enjoyed the game or have any feedback, then please leave us a review on our store page. Reviews help a ton with visibility and we'd love to hear players thoughts on the current state of the game - all feedback will help us towards our full launch next year!

We'll have more to share soon :)

Happy Cooking 
- Skyline Studios Games

notes.title: Cosmic Kitchen is now available in Early Access with a 15% launch discount
notes.content:
Cosmic Kitchen is now available in Early Access on Steam with a 15% launch discount! 🔥

Cook food in space to feed HANGRY monsters! 3 food themed galaxies are available on launch! 🎮

- Sunny Side System 🥓 (8 Levels + tutorials)
- Vortex Nebula 🍔 (8 Levels + tutorials)
- Great Blue Galaxy 🐟 (4 Levels + tutorials - more coming soon!)


There's currently 20 levels to play through with more content coming throughout the Early Access period. We'll be sharing a roadmap soon with planned content & features. Stay tuned for updates! 

Want to keep in the loop? We also have a Discord server - https://discord.com/invite/6n3tuxj3gn


Happy Cooking :)
- Skyline Studios Games

notes.title: Cosmic Kitchen's Demo is available to play for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hi all! 

We are thrilled to announce that we're taking part in Steam Next Fest with Cosmic Kitchen, as some may have already seen the demo has been available since Monday 14th and will be available until Monday 21st!

[b]So what's in the demo? [/b]
[list]
[*] 8 levels + 5 tutorial levels in Sunny Side System galaxy - our breakfast themed galaxy!
[*] 8 levels in Vortex Nebula - our fast food themed galaxy!
[*] Roughly 30-50 minutes worth of content. 
[*] 3 Monster customers - Nom, Snakka and Gob!
[/list]
We recently pushed a few updates to the demo as well, so to anyone who has had issues playing the demo we apologize! Good news is that the demo is entirely playable now! Here's a list of the recent patch notes below: 

[b]Steam Next Fest Demo Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue with cursor releasing food items randomly
[*] Fixed issue with asteroids clipping over each other
[*] Delete save data button now works
[*] Save data will now remain as long as you quit through start/pause screen (Alt+F4 doesn't save currently!!)
[/list]
[b]Future additions beyond Steam Next Fest:[/b]
[list]
[*] 3rd galaxy Great Blue Galaxy to be added back for Early Access
[*] New soundtracks for different galaxies
[*] Ketchup and Mustard sauces for Vortex Nebula recipes
[*] Mouse sensitivity and cursor size options along with additional settings for video/performance
[*] Autosaving feature
[*] Tutorial levels for Vortex Nebula & Great Blue Galaxy
[/list]
We'll be sharing a road map closer to Early Access - which is actually coming early November so stay tuned!


One last thing! If you could make any food in space what would you make and why? We'd love to hear your thoughts :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884850/891e48acc5aeb02b7d4ef68a5cd50aee2f28163f.gif[/img]
Happy cooking!

-Skyline Studios Games

notes.title: Take part in Cosmic Kitchen's Pre-Alpha Playtest today!
notes.content:
Hey all! 

We are excited to share a public build of Cosmic Kitchen! For the next 2 weeks you can join the Playtest by requesting access on our Steam page - see the screenshot below. The playtest will officially end on June 10th 2024, after which we aim to release a full demo within a couple of months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884850/9181b4a436bc2f85510004b8f7031518b6cf2512.png[/img]

[h1]Playtest Details[/h1]
In this playtest build we currently have 21 levels based in the Sunny Side System and Great Blue Galaxy, it should take up to a hour to complete all the levels. The levels in these galaxies may be changed in future builds, as well as including more food items! 

[i]Note: The levels in the Great Blue Galaxy are newly added, so some features are experimental and may cause bugs.[/i]

[h3]Here's a list of current known bugs, thanks to our Pre-Alpha Playtesters: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Stars for completing a level aren't aligned correctly with the empty stars. (Depends on Screen Size)
[*] Level 3 text goes off screen.
[*] Number counter for orders doesn't update when orders are complete.
[*] Fish have issues respawning in the Great Blue Galaxy.
[*] Level 12 is missing Level Number text from Level Select.
[*] Level 12 only gives 1 star.
[*] Great Blue Galaxy flickers on Level Select screen.[/list]

[h1]Cooking Cheat Sheet[/h1]
We've put together a handy guide with all the planets and space objects in the game to help you out below! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884850/c8684567bb11ab00b532bf5db0f5fb94a5455d95.png[/img]

[h1]Recipe Cheat Sheet[/h1]
Below we've put together a handy list of all the recipes currently in the demo and how to prepare them! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44884850/6c438e0b91073dcb96f6303ae0a62bb67dbfe585.png[/img]


[h1]Feedback Form[/h1]
Once you've completed the demo, if you could fill out this feedback form to help us improve the game, then that would be great!
https://forms.gle/Kq2J1qGTNoJVnN1r9


Also, if you'd like to be a Playtester for future builds Pre-Alpha and beyond, then fill out this form below!
https://forms.gle/CsUYSHn1efVZ5Cqf6

[h1]Community Discord[/h1]
We now have a Discord Server available as well for Skyline Studios Games, so you can talk all things Cosmic Kitchen & Escalar: The Tower of Treasures. You can join the Discord here: https://discord.gg/6n3tuxj3gn



Thanks for reading and we hope to share more Cosmic Kitchen news soon!
- Skyline Studios Games

notes.title: Cosmic Kitchen will be showcased at Barclays Games Frenzy 2024 this week!
notes.content:
Hey all! 

A lot going on this week in regards to Cosmic Kitchen! Firstly we're attending Barclays Games Frenzy 2024!! 🎉 

[h2][b]Barclays Games Frenzy 2024[/b][/h2]
This Thursday we will be showcasing a demo of Cosmic Kitchen at Barclays Headquarters in Canary Wharf! 🌌 🍳 

We'll be showcasing a similar demo to the WASD 2024 version, but with some bug fixes and a few visual changes. 

[h2][b]Demo & Playtester Form[/b][/h2]
For those who won't be attending, you'll be excited to hear that we have a demo coming to our Steam page really soon - an announcement will be made when this demo is public. 

If you would like to be more involved with the playtesting of Cosmic Kitchen, then we currently have a Pre-Alpha playtester form available. Fill out the form below and we'll be in touch via our Skyline Studios Games discord account! 👇 
https://forms.gle/89rqKqywmvCrYhPe9


We will have further rounds of playtesting up to release and will post when we're looking for more playtesters! All playtesters will be credited in the game credits on release.

[h2][b]So what's next for Cosmic Kitchen? [/b][/h2]
We recently made the decision to delay Cosmic Kitchen to Q4 2024 rather than the original planned release date of Q3 2024, this is due to the feedback we received at WASD 2024.

The reason for this delay is to polish and add new features that weren't originally planned for Cosmic Kitchen, one of those being an [b]Endless Mode[/b]! 

Currently in Endless Mode you will be given a selection of modifiers (planets), to add to your space kitchen! Over time you will unlock new modifiers and recipes, as well as more monsters to serve! Let's just say we plan for things to get a bit chaotic.... Hehehehe! 

This is still in the prototyping stage, so we're hoping to have something better to show in the near future!
[previewyoutube=m-TG98alqSY;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]Some updates are coming![/b][/h2]
Our steam page is a tad bit out of date, so we plan to update it with new information on Cosmic Kitchen's gameplay as well as some new GIFs/Images. Currently Cosmic Kitchen will have a Campaign mode with at least 5 galaxies planned, as well as Endless Mode. 

We are also considering adding up to 4 player co-op as suggested by many players at WASD 2024, this is something we're definitely looking into and will share more info in the near future!

Thanks for reading! 
- Skyline Studios Games
